From melt to ship, ASC process control supports on-time delivery and consistent results.

## Overview
American Steel Castings is built to produce large steel castings with repeatable chemistry control, predictable scheduling, and documented inspection. Whether you're sourcing slag pots or complex commercial castings, our process is designed to reduce risk through upfront review, disciplined production steps, and quality assurance from melt to shipment.
From pattern preparation through final finishing, each phase of production is managed to support consistency, performance, and delivery confidence. Our team works with a focus on process control, clear documentation, and coordination across departments so your casting moves through the foundry with fewer surprises. The result is a production approach built not just for making heavy castings, but for helping customers source them with greater confidence in quality, timing, and long-term reliability.
![Pattern Shop](https://www.americansteelcastings.com/files/user/pattern%2dshop%2ejpg)
## Pattern Shop
**Ensuring accuracy, repeatability, and long pattern life.**
Our dedicated pattern shop maintains both ASC-owned and customer-owned patterns. With inspection and maintenance after each use, pattern life can exceed 20 years, supporting consistent molding and more predictable results over time.  

[Ask About Pattern Storage & Maintenance](https://www.americansteelcastings.com/)
![Molding & Assembly](https://www.americansteelcastings.com/files/user/compressed%5fmolding%2ejpg)
## Molding & Assembly
**Every job starts with a complete review of pattern condition and molding requirements.**
We execute molding, mold coating, and assembly operations with an emphasis on repeatability and schedule control, especially for large castings where setup is a major driver of success.
[Share Your Casting Requirements](https://www.americansteelcastings.com/)
![Image](https://www.americansteelcastings.com/files/user/c7xx4414%5fcompressed%2ejpg)
![Image](https://www.americansteelcastings.com/files/user/c7xx4549%5fcompressed%2ejpg)

![Image](https://www.americansteelcastings.com/files/user/c7xx4386%5fcompressed%2ejpg)
## Melting & Metallurgy
**Heat sizes and chemistry control built for demanding specs.**
Our melt equipment includes a **50-ton Electric Arc Furnace (EAF)** and **two 9-ton induction furnaces**. Melt and pouring schedules are optimized for heat size and customer demand, with chemistry control confirmed through preliminary and final ladle testing using optical emission spectrometers and gas analyzers.  
  
[Ask About Grades & Chemistry Control](https://www.americansteelcastings.com/)
![Pouring & Shakeout](https://www.americansteelcastings.com/files/user/compressed%5fimage%5ffinalc7xx4504%2ejpg)
## Pouring & Shakeout
Tapping and pouring are completed under foundry supervision with temperature measurement and controlled pouring rates matched to the product. Shakeout timing is scheduled based on solidification models and casting temperature to support quality and safety.
  * Temperature measurement and pour control
  * Pour rates matched to casting requirements
  * Shakeout scheduled using modeling + temperature


[Review Pour Controls & Scheduling](https://www.americansteelcastings.com/)
![Heat Treatment](https://www.americansteelcastings.com/files/user/sr%2dquench%2d2%2ejpg)
## Heat Treatment
**Precision treatment to impart the material strength and toughness our customers demand.**
  * Annealing
  * Normalizing
  * Austenitizing & quenching (still air, compressed air, water, or furnace cooling)
  * Tempering/Stress Relieving


![Finishing](https://www.americansteelcastings.com/files/user/c8x4730%5fcompressed%2ejpg)
## Finishing
**Finishing operations include shot blasting, grinding, and chipping. Castings are thoroughly cleaned to deliver a high-quality finish and to prepare for inspection, handling, and shipment.**  
  
[Define Your Finish Requirements](https://www.americansteelcastings.com/)
![Quality Assurance](https://www.americansteelcastings.com/files/user/c8x4770%5fcompressed%2ejpg)
## Quality Assurance
**Testing on every order using certified systems and documented results.**
Quality control testing is completed on all orders and specified in each foundry job order. Final QA inspection is completed prior to shipment. Our quality system is ISO 9001 certified.
  * **NDT Capabilities:** UT, MT, PT, RT available per specification and documentation needs.
  * **Dimensional Inspection:** Inspection approach selected based on geometry, tolerance, and customer requirements—documented for your records.


[Request QA & Certification Details](https://www.americansteelcastings.com/)
![Engineering Support](https://www.americansteelcastings.com/files/user/engineering%2ejpg)
## Engineering Support
**ASC collaborates with end users to apply foundry and manufacturing expertise early—helping confirm castability, reduce risk, and align inspection requirements to performance needs.**
![Project Management](https://www.americansteelcastings.com/files/user/pm%2ejpg)
## Project Management
We provide a clear point of contact, documented milestones, and schedule visibility from PO through shipment so your team can plan with confidence.  
  
[Request QA & Certification Details](https://www.americansteelcastings.com/)

## Overview

From slag pots to large commercial castings, ASC supports customers who need domestic capacity, consistent results, and clear documentation. We collaborate early to confirm feasibility, align inspection requirements, and reduce late-stage surprises.

## Steel
**Steel equipment built for extreme heat, impact resistance, and repeated cycling.**
Steelmaking is where ASC leads. As the #1 supplier of slag pots in the U.S., we understand the realities of melt-shop environments: thermal shock, heavy handling, and the cost of unplanned changeouts.   
  
We help steel producers protect uptime with steel castings engineered for durability, and backed by disciplined production processes.
  * Steelmaking Vessels and Handling: 
    * Slag Pots, Ladle Shells, Ladle Trunnion Rings / Bail Assemblies, Torpedo Ladles
  * BOF / Converter Components 
    * Trunnion Rings, Converter Vessel Shell Sections
  * Rolling Mill Structural Castings 
    * Mill Housings (Stands), Backup Roll Chocks (Bearing Chocks), Work Roll Chocks, Rolling Mill Pinion Housings / Drive Housings, Edger and Vertical Roll Housings
  * Forging Press Structures 
    * Forging Press Frames (Crown, Bed, Columns), Forging Press Bolsters, Hydraulic Forging Press Cylinders and Housings
  * Continuous Casting Machine Components 
    * Tundish Cars / Tundish Structures, Stand Guide Frames / Segment Frames, Dummy Bar Heads, Mold Oscillation Tables
  * Material Handling & Transfer Equipment 
    * Scrap Charging Buckets / Shells, Transfer Cars and Ladle Turrets, Hot Metal Ladle Cars, Drop Balls
  * Iron & Blast Furnace Components 
    * Blast Furnace Tuyere Stocks / Bustle Pipes, Skip Car Bodies, Cast House Equipment

  * Grinding Mill Components

  * Dragline Components

  * Mineral Processing - Autogenous/SAG Mill Liners

# Why ASC
American Steel Castings is a U.S. steel foundry based in Midland, Pennsylvania. We specialize in high-quality slag pots and heavy custom steel castings, backed by responsive technical support for demanding applications. With domestic production, you get faster lead times and more predictable total costs, without the risk of international shipping delays or tariffs.
[made in the usa](https://www.americansteelcastings.com/why-asc#made)
[100-year history](https://www.americansteelcastings.com/why-asc#experience)
[Proprietary and Standard ASTM Steel Grades](https://www.americansteelcastings.com/why-asc#performance)
[On-Site Sales & Technical Service Support](https://www.americansteelcastings.com/why-asc#support)
[On-Time Delivery & Planned Scheduling](https://www.americansteelcastings.com/why-asc#on-time)
## Built for the Work That Can't Slip
American Steel Castings supports customers who can’t afford delays, rework, or unpredictable lead times. From slag pots to large commercial castings, we combine domestic capacity with disciplined process control and responsive technical support, so your team can plan confidently and keep operations moving.
![](https://www.americansteelcastings.com/files/user/c8x4798%5fcompressed%2ejpg)
### Proudly Made in the USA
Our castings are produced domestically at our Pennsylvania foundry. You get clearer communication, fewer supply chain surprises, and delivery you can plan around, especially when outages, changeouts, or project milestones drive the schedule.
  * Domestic production and shipping coordination
  * Direct access to sales and technical support
  * Responsive quoting and feasibility review


[Ask About Lead Times](https://www.americansteelcastings.com/contact "Ask About Lead Times")
![](https://www.americansteelcastings.com/files/user/c8x4770%5fcompressed%2ejpg)
### A Foundry Built on Experience
We’ve earned long-term relationships by doing the fundamentals well, then doing them consistently.
We produce steel castings for industries that demand performance under pressure. That history matters because it shows up in the day-to-day: disciplined execution, practical problem-solving, and a team that understands what “mission-critical” really means.
[Meet our leadership](https://www.americansteelcastings.com/why-asc#leadership "Meet our leadership")
## Steel Grades Matched to Performance
Your casting requirements should drive the metallurgy—not the other way around. ASC produces standard ASTM steel grades and proprietary grades developed for demanding applications. We’ll help you align material selection, heat treatment, and inspection requirements to the environment your casting will face.
[Ask About Grades & Metallurgy](https://www.americansteelcastings.com/contact "Ask About Grades & Metallurgy")

#### Proprietary grades available where performance demands it
#### Documented chemistry control and heat treat cycles (as required)

## Real Support from People Who Know
When questions come up, you need answers from people close to the work. Our on-site sales and technical support teams work closely with operations to answer feasibility questions, clarify requirements, and troubleshoot issues quickly. The result is fewer delays, cleaner handoffs, and better outcomes.
  * Feasibility reviews and requirement alignment
  * Documentation, inspection, and spec coordination
  * Practical recommendations to reduce risk and rework


[Talk to a Casting Specialist](https://www.americansteelcastings.com/contact)
## On-Time Delivery, Planned Around Your Schedule
### Delivery performance isn't an add-on. It's built into how we plan work.
Many ASC customers operate around shutdowns, changeouts, and tight outage windows. We coordinate production and delivery sequencing to align with your needs, so castings arrive when they’re useful—not just when they’re finished.  
  
From pattern readiness and scheduling through finishing and inspection, we manage each job with clear milestones and proactive communication. If schedule risk appears, we surface it early so your team can make informed decisions and keep work moving.
#### Milestone-based planning from PO through shipment
#### Scheduling aligned to meet your needs
#### Proactive communication around schedule risk
#### Support for repeat programs with predictable cadence
![Why Domestic?](https://www.americansteelcastings.com/files/user/c8x4730%5fcompressed%2ejpg)
## Why Domestic?
American-made slag pots and large steel castings provide superior quality, faster lead times, and lower total ownership cost by avoiding international shipping delays and tariffs.
